hero.title: Hello, I'm Eduardo
hero.description: I’m more than just a UX/UI Designer — I’m passionate about absolutely everything that involves the world of design. On this page, you’ll find more about me, my work tools, and some of the projects I’ve developed. I hope you enjoy it :)

experience.title: Experience
experience.freelancer-subtitle: I created my first artworks at the age of 12, and today I design a wide variety of graphic materials, such as logos, banners, and more.
experience.demolay-subtitle: Leader of the marketing committee (state of Paraná), managing the organization’s social media and website for DeMolay, the largest youth organization in the world.
experience.grupoazul-subtitle: Responsible for maintaining the App Health, Vizi Saúde, and Azul Controle systems, as well as fully developing the InPlay Sports system.
